$comment: Cost model that skill_eval.py reads at import. PRICES rows are USD per million tokens (input, output), each with its source and the date it was read. No Codex or OpenAI price is verified from a primary source: see codex. Costs are API-equivalent (usage x API prices), not spend.

codex.note: UNVERIFIED: Codex/OpenAI prices are not listed because they are not verified from a primary source; pass --price codex=IN,OUT.

claude-haiku-5-5.note: Haiku 5.5 row for prompts up to 100,000 tokens

DEFAULT_TOKENS.note: Assumed tokens per call (input, output). Assumptions, not measurements: replace with --tokens after a pilot.

CLAUDE_CAP_HEADROOM.note: H: Claude --max-budget-usd gets only this share of the remaining budget, because how far the CLI can overshoot its cap is not documented.

WORST_CASE_FACTOR.note: H: the worst-case bound of a call is assumed tokens x this factor x price. Codex has no per-call cap, so its budget is a SOFT LIMIT: a call starts only when this bound fits the remaining budget.
